category_edits.rationale: Blend each current GRU state with its causal, masked recency-weighted prefix mean: 75% current state and 25% pooled states with a five-interaction half-life. At inference this blends the last valid state with its history summary. The generated predictor imports the same model class, preserving training/inference consistency without additional edits.

change_summary: Change only recurrent-state readout to a 75/25 current-state and recency-pooling blend; preserve the GRU backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer, routing, and epoch settings.
